subject: Unexpected mid-cycle spike after replay — request to pause collection and token export
messages:
From: Elena Petrova <accounts@lumina.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 11:12:37 +02:00
Subject: Mid-cycle usage spike — pause collection & token export request

Hi Neha,

We're seeing a big, unexpected token spike on the July 28–30 window (attached sample). We reran a large streaming ingest job as part of a reprocessing pass last week — that should have re-used existing KV prefixes but it looks like Redwood billed the replay as new consumption. Total delta ~1.14M tokens on our July invoice.

Because Lumina is EU-registered and this ties into our VAT reporting, we need a few things before we can clear payment:
- Pause the collection for the disputed line item (invoice #R-2026-07-4512) while this is investigated.
- Export of per-request token counts for the dates 2026-07-28 -> 2026-07-30 (CSV).
- Confirmation of whether tokens resulting from replayed requests are treated as distinct billable tokens vs deduplicated by request_id/stream_id.
- Any guidance on VAT treatment if charges are reversed (reverse-charge vs credit memo).

I've attached a small replay_batch_log.csv (first 500 rows) and a pointer to our internal run id (stream-7f2b). Please treat this as urgent — our finance team has a month-end close next week.

Thanks,
Elena Petrova
Head of Finance (Lumina AI)
accounts@lumina.ai

--
Attachment: replay_batch_log.csv (CSV, 42 KB, first 500 rows)
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Elena Petrova <accounts@lumina.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 12:03:21 +02:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle usage spike — pause collection & token export request

Elena — thanks for the quick note and the sample log. We're treating this as a billing hold request and will not progress collection for invoice R-2026-07-4512 until we validate.

Immediate next steps from our side:
1) Ben (billing ops) — can you pull a per-request export for Lumina covering 2026-07-27 00:00 UTC through 2026-07-31 23:59 UTC and include request_id, stream_id, token_in, token_out, and whether the request hit KV-cache? Please include any duplication markers or retry flags.
2) Marissa (rev ops/legal) — please advise on VAT/credit memo language and whether we should treat this as an invoice reversal vs credit memo for EU VAT.
3) Rafael (inference infra) — can you check for any replay-related telemetry for stream-7f2b and whether replayed batches produced new request_ids?

Elena: we'll target an initial response within 48 hours with an export and a proposed remediation (credit memo or reversal). If you can also attach your internal run id trace (job id) and the exact invoice line you believe is impacted that will speed things up.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Customer Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Note: pausing collection for invoice R-2026-07-4512 pending investigation
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 09:17:04 +00:00
Subject: RE: Mid-cycle usage spike — pause collection & token export request

Neha — quick analysis from billing side (preliminary):

I pulled the per-request export for Lumina and cross-referenced with our streaming telemetry. Findings:
- We observe a cluster of requests tied to stream-7f2b with nearly identical payload hashes that generated distinct request_id values on 2026-07-29T02:41:xxZ -> 2026-07-29T03:05:xxZ.
- Duplication markers: 78% of the suspect rows show a retry_count > 0 and a downstream code path that did not consult the prefix cache, which caused full tokenization and billing.
- Net impact: ~1,140,372 tokens billed that are plausibly attributable to replayed batches.

Proposed remediation options:
A) Issue a credit memo for the full disputed amount and apply to invoice R-2026-07-4512 (preferred for speed). VAT handling: credit memo will reduce the taxable base; for EU customers we can apply reverse-charge accounting on the adjusted invoice if Lumina confirms reseller/residence details.
B) Full invoice reversal + re-issue (takes longer; cleaner ledger).

Recommended operational steps: 1) Place invoice on hold (Neha done), 2) Create provisional credit memo draft for customer to approve, 3) Run a one-off backfill that marks the duplicated request_ids as non-billable and records the adjustment in usage ledger.

I've included a sample snippet in the Drive link (usage-export-20260805.csv) and created a HubSpot activity under deal DL-2025-LUM-1793. Rafael — the infra team should provide the exact request_id list so we can mark them non-billable.

Ben Carter
Sr. Billing Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: (see related link) usage-export-20260805.csv (export ID: exp-87912)
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Elena Petrova <accounts@lumina.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 15:28:11 +02:00
Subject: Resolution plan — provisional credit & next steps (Lumina AI)

Hi Elena,

Thanks for sending the log and for your patience — internal review complete. Summary and next steps below.

What we found
- Our telemetry shows replayed batches (stream-7f2b) produced distinct request_ids and bypassed prefix/KV-cache for a subset of the runs, generating ~1,140,372 additional billed tokens.

What Redwood will do (timeline)
1) We will issue a provisional credit memo for the disputed tokens, amount will appear as a credit line on invoice R-2026-07-4512. Draft credit memo and supporting export (request_id list + token counts) will be shared within 5 business days. (Attachment: provisional-credit-statement- LuminaAI.pdf)
2) Collections: invoice R-2026-07-4512 will remain on hold until the credit memo is processed. No collection attempts will be made while this thread is open.
3) VAT treatment: Marissa will reach out separately with the credit memo wording and whether reverse-charge flow applies. In short, we can either:
   - Issue a credit memo (adjust taxable base) or
   - Reverse and reissue the invoice if Lumina prefers (this takes longer).
4) Infra remediation: Rafael will provide the full request_id list to Ben for ledger marking so the tokens are non-billable in our system.

Action items for Lumina
- Please confirm the preferred path for VAT (credit memo vs full reversal) and supply your EU VAT registration number or reseller evidence if applicable.
- If you can share the job trace id (server-side) and any internal correlator beyond stream-7f2b that will help Rafael confirm the scope faster.

I'll follow up as soon as the draft credit memo is ready. Sorry for the disruption and thanks again for surfacing this quickly — we want to get it squared away before your month-end close.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Customer Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
